journey.name: Honest diagnostics and local haptics
journey.description: Start on Controller with Bluetooth stopped and no sender session. Phone vibration requires human confirmation on suitable hardware; an event label alone does not prove physical vibration.

actions.action: Verify that RSSI, Round-trip latency, and Receiver packet loss each show Unavailable.
Verify that Local sender measurements shows No sender session.
Verify that No sender session. remains displayed.
Scroll until Test phone vibration is visible.
Verify that Phone haptics explains that only this phone is tested and remote rumble is not reported.
Verify that the app remains on Diagnostics without crashing.
